content_sections.heading: DMSRDE Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DMSRDE Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download DMSRDE Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: DMSRDE Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Research Associate and 2 for Junior Research Fellow.

content_sections.heading: DMSRDE Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Associate: Ph.D. or equivalent degree in Chemistry from a recognized university. Junior Research Fellow: Post Graduate degree in relevant discipline (basic sciences) in first division with NET qualification OR Graduate degree in professional course (B.E./B.Tech.) in relevant discipline in first division with NET/GATE OR Post graduate degree in professional course (M.E./M.Tech.) in relevant discipline in first division both at Graduate and Post graduate level.

content_sections.heading: DMSRDE Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Research Associate: 35 years Junior Research Fellow: 28 years Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates (OBC creamy layer not eligible). Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DMSRDE Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by DMSRDE?
faq.answer: DMSRDE has announced a total of 3 vacancies for the posts of Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow. These positions are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for DMSRDE recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for DMSRDE recruitment is scheduled to be held on 02 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: For the Research Associate position, candidates must possess a Ph.D. or equivalent degree in Chemistry from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow will receive a consolidated monthly stipend of ₹ 37,000/-. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for DMSRDE recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this DMSRDE recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these contractual posts at DMSRDE?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview for DMSRDE recruitment be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Defence Materials and Stores Research and Development Establishment (DMSRDE), Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, 208004.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any age relaxations for SC/ST and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided: 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates. However, OBC creamy layer candidates are not eligible for this relaxation.
